chapter: Regal Theatre, bebop and the Woody Herman date
title: Metronome review, 78s and reissues of the Herman sides
summary: DeMichael kept the 78s and a review; Saunders never got copies and asks about the MCA reissue.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: I remember reading a review in Metronome about it, and it mentioned that you guys were on it. I got a copy of it.
Oh, yeah, well, I didn't know.
I still have the '78s.
No kidding?
Yeah.
Oh, beautiful. You know, I never got a copy of any of the records.
Really? They been reissued on -- MCA has a Woody Herman album.
Uh-huh. You know --
That's Decca. MCA bought Decca.
Right, right.
And I'm pretty sure that those sides are available.
Well, I would like to pick up some if they are, because -- for my collection. If you know the name of the album.
I'll look it up.
Right, right, right.
Next time we get together, I'll --
That'd be great, that'd be great.
But I have the 78's, too, at least of some of the stuff.
Uh-huh.
Ever since I was in high school.
Right, right.
